item.content:encoded:
Is seeking interview guests from music, theater, film, television, and comedy who have a compelling personal story to share alongside their professional work.

Show Name: *

It's Your Break

Show Description: *

It’s Your Break is a podcast hosted by Jonathan Mertz that invites listeners to step away from the daily grind and make time for laughter, discovery, and connection. Launched in 2010, the show combines engaging interviews, everyday perspectives, practical ideas, and a little silliness—all rooted in the belief that everyone deserves a moment to enjoy life. With topics ranging from entertainment and creative careers to relationships and everyday challenges, the show explores the experiences that make people interesting.

Guest Request: We’re interested in the experiences that shaped the person behind the entertainer: unexpected beginnings, obstacles overcome, career reinventions, meaningful turning points, and lessons learned along the way. Whether you’re an emerging talent, an established performer, or someone whose journey has taken an unconventional path, we’d love to learn what makes your story worth telling. Publicists, managers, agents, and entertainers are welcome to submit.

item.title: Michael Upstone, Frequency Healing Expert
item.dc:creator: jessica matsuo
item.description: Michael Upstone has 18 years of experience in Frequency healing and energy-based regeneration devices. He has used over 25 modalities and treated around 1,000 people. He trains doctors, clinicians and home healers to resolve injuries and chronic illnesses, and remove scarring - in record time.
item.content:encoded:
Michael Upstone has 18 years of experience in Frequency healing and energy-based regeneration devices. He has used over 25 modalities and treated around 1,000 people. He trains doctors, clinicians and home healers to resolve injuries and chronic illnesses, and remove scarring - in record time.

The cutting edge of medical science involves using energy for healing and a wide range of human performance enhancement.

The very best options come from space medical research. The results don't just include rapid healing but also regeneration, which means undoing injuries, illnesses, and even emotional traumas... as if they never happened.

Michael Upstone is the President of Keep Health, based in Austria. He is the author of a bestselling 3-book series on Frequency Healing, which includes hundreds of images, X-rays and charts of results - that Amazon readers describe as 'astounding'.

Frequency Healing is being used to boost IQ and enhance business performance, creativity, and sports performance, as well as reduce scars and wrinkles and treat animals. Keep Health is at the forefront of energy healing research, training, and adoption, which is being propelled by home users, not just clinicians and doctors, and the area is forecast to grow by 10x over the next 10 years.

My book, Frequency Healing: Energy Healing on Amazon, shows X-rays of bone regeneration after osteomyelitis, a blood blister that totally vanishes after one hour as if it had never happened - on a 91-year old woman with Alzheimers - and other stunning examples of frequency healing.

The first person I treated was a woman who had had a stroke. I treated her for about an hour, and immediately afterwards, she stood up out of her wheelchair and balanced on what had been her bad leg. It sounds miraculous, impossible - and this is why Keep Health gathers the research and evidence, as well as providing equipment, training and support to members.

Quite simply, you are never going to hear this information anywhere else. Anyone interested in anything from health, to performance enhancement, to improving their appearance, to unlocking the genius of their child, is going to find inspiring, practical information they can apply to enhance their own lives and those of their family and friends.

Interview Michael Upstone, Frequency Healing expert, to discuss…

  • Real-World Healing Results

  • What Other Uses Apply to Frequency Technologies?

  • Core Science & Principles

  • Practical Issues (Equipment Selection and Use)

  • Challenges & Controversies - Bad Science is Endemic

  • Personal & Inspirational Stories

  • [Topic and Question Suggestion Sheet Available]


Michael Upstone Guest Expert Interview Credentials

  • The author of the bestselling Frequency Healing book series on Amazon.

  • 18 years of experience with frequency healing, using over 25 modalities.

  • Treating over 1,000 people.

  • Training and supporting home healers, doctors and experienced clinicians with the best technologies.
